summary: Build ISO 22361 crisis management capability with PECB training, practical examples, scenario quizzes, and preparation for the Lead Crisis Manager exam.
audienceIntro: This ISO 22361 course suits professionals who help establish, lead, or support an organizational crisis management capability. The course page also identifies decision-makers, senior managers involved in crisis response, and professionals seeking in-depth crisis management knowledge as intended learners.
prerequisites: You should have a fundamental understanding of crisis management concepts, framework, and process.
